_comment: Generated by _build/sync_planner_catalog.py — do not edit by hand (regenerated on every --check/--write run). Maps Event Layout Planner item keys (site/planner/catalog.json) to RentKit/Adelie inventory item ids, resolved via planner item.sku -> _build/sku_to_adelie_id.json. Single-item SKUs map to a bare id string. Multi-size SKUs (array values in sku_to_adelie_id.json) are matched by size token: the first NxM token in the planner item label (e.g. '12×12', with '×' normalised to 'x') must equal the first NxM token in the mapping entry's label — whole-token equality, so '8x8' never matches '18x18'. A planner item whose sku maps to an array but whose label carries no size token gets the full array of ids. Planner items with no resolvable mapping are listed in _unmapped rather than dropped.
